versions.content: The stored port mirror configuration shall be marked as "to be deleted" by calling EthSwt_DeletePortMirrorConfiguration , if the port mirror- ing of the given Ethernet switch index is disabled (see [SWS_EthSwt_91022]. Other- wise the request to delete the port mirror configuration shall be rejected.
